scripts.test: pnpm --filter @zaydiscold/amazon-kindle-cli test && pnpm --filter @zaydiscold/amazon-kindle-mcp test && node scripts/test-python.mjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @zaydiscold/amazon-kindle-cli typecheck && pnpm --filter @zaydiscold/amazon-kindle-cli build && pnpm --filter @zaydiscold/amazon-kindle-mcp typecheck
scripts.format: prettier --write cli/src cli/test mcp/src mcp/test scripts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check cli/src cli/test mcp/src mcp/test scripts
